name: UI Theme Plugin
description: SDK-only theme package workflows and semantic appearance requests. Production host mutation remains fail-closed until a verified appearance provider is installed.

permissions.reason: Registers theme package status and import actions.
Reads the SDK theme status snapshot through the project-scoped Cubism read capability.
Shows the fake-host theme package import confirmation dialog.
Requests a ZIP theme package path for the fake-host import workflow.
Shows theme package status, import progress, and appearance apply results.
Applies or restores a reviewed built-in theme through the semantic appearance service.
